facts.fact: 四人组背景：Grant 是橄榄球队长，全是 jocks，靠体育奖学金上的大学。
facts.anchor: Grant was the captain of the football team. They were all jocks. Scholarships to play at college.

facts.fact: 他们回乡养家、做地产开发——脚下整个小区就是他们的作品。
facts.anchor: They came back, wanted to raise families, got into property development.

facts.fact: 开发的另一面：有人被挤出——租金上涨、孩子玩耍的街区变得抢手。
facts.anchor: Some people got priced out. Rents started climbing.

facts.fact: 圣人清单：Grant 教少棒、Gallagher 开舞蹈学校、Harper 扶老奶奶、Cook 夫妇办年度玩具捐赠。
facts.anchor: he and Rebecca ran the yearly toy drive for kids in Dunning

facts.fact: Alex 金句：我能想象——而且不幸的是，我不必想象。
facts.anchor: Because I can imagine. And unfortunately, I don’t have to.

facts.fact: Alex 求得 Scott 许可宣布死讯：尸体在 Dunning 以外约五英里的谷仓被发现。
facts.anchor: we discovered Rebecca Cook’s body in a barn approximately five miles outside of Dunning.

facts.fact: Alex 问全员：最近一两周有没有收到可疑邮件——无人应答。
facts.anchor: Has anyone in this room received any suspicious mail in the last week or two?

facts.fact: April 说「我们没有秘密」——Alex 心想：每个人都有秘密，不管告没告诉配偶。
facts.anchor: But everyone had secrets, she thought, whether they told their spouses or not.

facts.fact: Grant 拒绝送 April 进警局：城堡条款适用——家是堡垒，家家有合法枪支。
facts.anchor: castle doctrine applies. A man’s home is his fortress

facts.fact: Grant 放话：查清之前不让这屋里任何人离开视线。
facts.anchor: I’m not letting a single person in this room out of my sight

facts.fact: Scott 崩溃爆发：抓住 Alex 衣领把她推进墙。
facts.anchor: seizing her by the collar and driving her backward into the wall.

facts.fact: Alex 创伤闪回：记忆弹片——一个记不起、却忘不掉的另一种人生。
facts.anchor: memory shrapnel of another life she couldn’t remember, but could never forget.

facts.fact: 章末：客气的时间过去了——Alex 握着手枪走回厨房。
facts.anchor: And her hand firmly around the grip of her pistol.
